policy: File/symbol-level exceptions only. Never widen a rule to a whole directory. D-12 entries are formalized by DES-B §2.3/§18.1 T20-D12-01..13 and must keep status accepted; used entries with any other status fail the gate. Port location exceptions are defined by DES-A §27.6.2 / DES-B §18.1: exact path + symbols subset + status accepted-location-exception; an unregistered port path fails D-09/D-11. T-23 migrated all port declarations to contracts/** (and DTOs to model/**); only PORT-LOC-01 remains for the frozen common/utils ClockPort/IdPort signatures. Port exceptions never widen D-12.
